# Metric inventory: bff-signup

<!-- Generated by `make metrics-inventory` (.github/scripts/metrics-inventory.py) from the
     Platform Observability Registry in platform-gincommon v2.7.0 and a real /metrics
     scrape of this service. Do not edit; CI fails when this file is out of date. -->

Every series carries the centrally injected const labels `domain` (`bff`), `service` (`bff-signup`) and `environment`. The tables list each metric's own labels only. Status is the registry's: `approved`, or `proposed` (awaiting observability-governance ratification). Tier 3 metrics are this service's own and need no registry entry. See [README.md](README.md) for how the tiers are built, enforced and migrated.

## Tier 1: platform-shared metrics

### Emitted by platform-gincommon

The HTTP server middleware (`gincommon.ObservabilityMiddlewares`) and build info. This service does not construct these. HTTP series appear once a route has served a request.

| Metric | Type | Status | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `platform_build_info` | gauge | proposed | `version` | Always 1; the version label carries the build of the emitting service. |
| `platform_http_requests_total` | counter | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP requests completed by the server, including recovered panics (counted as 5xx). |
| `platform_http_request_duration_seconds` | histogram (request_duration) | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP server request latency in seconds, measured by MetricsMiddleware. |
| `platform_http_request_size_bytes` | histogram (payload_size) | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP request body size in bytes from Content-Length (not observed when the length is unknown, e.g. chunked uploads). |
| `platform_http_response_size_bytes` | histogram (payload_size) | proposed | `method`, `route`, `status_class`, `error_class` | HTTP response body size in bytes. |
| `platform_http_active_requests` | gauge | proposed | `route` | HTTP requests currently being handled. |
| `platform_http_panics_total` | counter | proposed | `method`, `route` | HTTP handler panics recovered by the middleware stack. |
| `platform_http_rate_limited_requests_total` | counter | proposed | `method`, `route` | HTTP requests answered with 429 Too Many Requests. |
| `platform_http_request_timeouts_total` | counter | proposed | `method`, `route` | HTTP requests whose TimeoutMiddleware deadline expired before the handler responded. |
| `platform_unclassified_errors_total` | counter | approved | `transport` | Errors that reached the top-level error handler unclassified and were answered as a generic internal error (HTTP 500 internal-error, gRPC Internal): a programming defect. |

### Built and recorded by this service

Built from the registry with `gincommon.NewSharedHistogramVec` (`internal/adapter/outbound/metrics/business.go`, `registerShared`), so the name, help, labels and buckets are the registry's.

| Metric | Owner | Type | Status | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `platform_dependency_request_seconds` | platform-events | histogram (dependency_request) | proposed | `dependency`, `operation`, `outcome` | Client-observed wall time of one call to an external dependency — SNS (publish, publish_batch), SQS (receive_message, delete_message, change_message_visibility, send_message, get_queue_attributes, get_queue_url) or the configured schema-registry codec (encode, decode) — by outcome. The _count series counts calls. receive_message is a long poll: its duration includes up to WaitTimeSeconds (default 20 s) of waiting on an empty queue, so exclude it from latency views (it stays meaningful for error rates). |

## Tier 2: BFF domain-shared metrics (`bff_*`)

None. The registry has no `bff_*` entries, and bff-signup is the only BFF service, so nothing is shared within the domain yet.

## Tier 3: service-specific metrics (`bff_signup_*`)

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bff_signup_captcha_challenged_total` | counter | `result` | Turnstile siteverify calls, by result: pass (success=true), fail (success=false), error (transport/HTTP error). LLD §11.2. |
| `bff_signup_dependency_call_duration_seconds` | histogram | `dependency`, `outcome` | Wall time of synchronous calls to external dependencies (RP-1, I-1, eligibility, PUB-1, Turnstile, Catalog, Billing), by dependency and outcome. Authoritative until platform_dependency_request_seconds is ratified (registry.go). LLD §11.2. |
| `bff_signup_form_started_total` | counter | `mode` | SB-1 sessions successfully created (mode is always trial: SB-1 precedes the path choice). Baseline for signup funnel (LLD §11.2). |
| `bff_signup_form_submitted_total` | counter | `mode` | SB-2 (mode=trial) and SB-5 (mode=paid) requests received before any processing. Paired with bff_signup_provisioning_succeeded_total for funnel drop-off (LLD §11.2). |
| `bff_signup_handoff_resumed_total` | counter | `trigger` | I-1 retry attempts on an existing handoff, by trigger: poll (SB-3), resubmit (SB-2 same-session retry), slug_change (SB-4). LLD §11.2. |
| `bff_signup_password_hash_duration_seconds` | histogram | - | PBKDF2-SHA512 hashing time per SB-2 request (~100–200 ms CPU; drives HPA sizing and SLO-2 budget). LLD §11.2, §10.6, §13.2. |
| `bff_signup_provisioning_failed_total` | counter | `mode`, `reason`, `stage` | Signups stuck in state=failed after exhausting the 15-min resume window, by mode, stage (eligibility\|realm_provisioner\|org_membership) and reason (unavailable\|contract_error\|exhausted). LLD §11.2. |
| `bff_signup_provisioning_succeeded_total` | counter | `mode`, `strategy` | Signups that reached state=completed, by mode (trial\|paid) and strategy: inline (I-1 succeeded within SB-2/SB-5), resume (SB-3 poll completed it), slug_change (SB-4 completed it). LLD §11.2. |
| `bff_signup_rate_limited_total` | counter | `scope` | Requests rejected by abuse controls, by scope: ip (RATE_SIGNUPS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR, SB-2/SB-5), email (RATE_ATTEMPTS_PER_EMAIL_PER_DAY, SB-2/SB-5), session (RATE_SESSIONS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR, SB-1), poll (RATE_POLLS_PER_SESSION_PER_MIN, SB-3). LLD §11.2. |
